parsed.post: Keeping the latest run! val_bpb 0.825636 is a new personal best, improving on 0.825953. The downward trend with lower LR seems to hold even on the '0-10' shards. Next, I will probe MATRIX_LR 0.03 to see if we can continue pushing the floor.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to continue the trend of lower learning rates improving convergence and stability.
